description: This source file defines the Coroutine class within the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace. It implements an asynchronous coroutine mechanism using generators, allowing for sequential async operations that are less verbose and easier to manage. The class facilitates creating, managing, and resolving promises based on generator functions, enabling writing asynchronous code in a synchronous style.

classes.name: Coroutine
classes.description: A final class that creates and manages a promise based on a generator function, allowing asynchronous code to be written in a sequential manner by yielding promises and handling their resolution or rejection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Coroutine object with a generator function, starts the generator, and manages the promise resolution process.

methods.name: of
methods.description: A static factory method to create a new Coroutine instance with a generator function.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Attaches fulfillment and rejection handlers to the underlying promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Attaches a rejection handler to the underlying promise.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks and waits for the promise to settle, returning its value or throwing an exception.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise (pending, fulfilled, rejected).

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a given reason.

methods.name: nextCoroutine
methods.description: Internal method to process the next step of the generator based on a yielded value.

methods.name: _handleSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful resolution of the yielded promise and advances the generator.

methods.name: _handleFailure
methods.description: Handles failure of the yielded promise and throws the exception into the generator.
